use_when: A durable important character is created or promoted to plot relevance.

fields.fear: What they will avoid or hide.
resources: Tools, allies, status, knowledge, money, force, access.
fields.secret: A fact that can create later consequence.
fields.god_view: Truth visible to the game master or god, not necessarily public.

constraints: Do not make every character loyal or villainous.
Tie at least one field to a resource, institution, environment, or prior event.
Keep the public state shorter than the private semantic draft.
